name: Gravity anomaly (free-air)
citation: Pavlis, N. K., Holmes, S. A., Kenyon, S. C., Factor, J. K. (2012). The development and evaluation of the Earth Gravitational Model 2008 (EGM2008). Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth, 117, B04406. doi:10.1029/2011JB008916
description: Free-air gravity anomaly in spherical approximation, dg = -dT/dr - 2T/r, evaluated on the WGS84 ellipsoid (h = 0). T = EGM2008 (tide-free, degrees 2..2190) minus the WGS84 normal potential (even zonal terms to degree 10). Coefficients from the ICGEM copy of EGM2008. Bilinear-resampled to geographic (EPSG:4326) pixel centres at level 5, 2x2 means below.
